summary: Energy Transition Special Opportunities (a blank-check company) filed an 8-K reporting the consummation of its initial public offering on May 18, 2026, after its S-1 became effective on May 14, 2026. The offering comprised 15,000,000 units at $10.00 per unit, generating $150M in gross proceeds. Each unit consists of one Class A ordinary share and one-half of one redeemable warrant (exercise price $11.50). The underwriter was Cohen Company Capital Markets. The filing also notes entry into the underwriting, warrant, and insider letter agreements. As a SPAC IPO, this represents the start of a two-year window to identify and complete a business combination. Watch for subsequent de-SPAC announcements.
